errors.text_span: Оста Y е разделена на четири деления
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not divided into four divisions. It ranges from 0 to 3 with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.5 (0.00, 0.50, 1.00, 1.50, 2.00, 2.50, 3.00), creating six main intervals.
The Y-axis itself is not labeled. The label 'Купувачи (в млрд.)' corresponds to the blue area/line series and is located in the legend at the bottom of the chart.
The 7.8% growth value corresponds to the period from 2017 to 2018 (i.e., the growth in 2018), not the year 2017.

errors.text_span: Процентното увеличение също показва възходяща тенденция
errors.evidence: The percentage increase does not show a simple upward trend. It decreases from 7.8% to 4.4% between 2018 and 2021, before increasing again.

The description omits most of the percentage growth data points shown on the orange line. It fails to mention the values for 2019 (7.3%), 2020 (6.8%), 2021 (4.4%), and 2022 (8.4%), which are crucial for understanding the fluctuating trend.

errors.text_span: от 7,8% през 2017 г. до 13,8% през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: This repeats the error of misattributing the percentage growth to the wrong year. The 7.8% growth is for the year 2018, and the 13.8% is for 2023, representing the growth from the previous year in each case.

errors.text_span: като през 2017 г. е 1,66 милиарда, а през 2023 г. достига 2,64 милиарда.
errors.evidence: This phrase repeats the exact start and end values for the number of shoppers, which were already stated in a previous paragraph ('Синята линия ... започва от 1,66 милиарда през 2017 г. и достига до 2,64 милиарда през 2023 г.')
The phrase 'като ето етикетирана като' is grammatically incorrect and awkward in Bulgarian.
